hub_observations.observation: Citation descendants span psychometrics, Theory of Mind, personas, multi-agent behavior, AI psychology methodology and interpretability.
Sycophancy lineage expands from factual belief-mirroring toward benchmark design, social face-preservation and mitigation.
Deceptive-policy lineage connects older scheming/situational-awareness work to later emergent-misalignment research.
Experience-following memory work is already feeding adaptive-memory and self-evolving-agent research.
